summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting an adjustment to the exercise price of its Series A Warrants and a warrant issued with a convertible promissory note, effective June 1, 2026, set at $1.014992 per ordinary share. No other terms, external events, or changes in corporate strategy are provided. This is a routine contractual adjustment, not a special situation. The filing is incorporated by reference into several registration statements.
